notes.title: v1.5.0.2 - The Tower Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've gotten a ton of great feedback on The Tower update, so we wanted to put out a small update adding new content and fixing a few bugs.

For patch notes for the original 1.5.0 update, see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1359120/view/4174343559693801480?l=english]here[/url].

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Tower now goes up to a maximum of 100 floors.
[*] Added 9 new enemies to the top floors.
[*] New item - Infernal Blade. Hero only. +4 attack.
[*] New item - Infernal Bow. Archer only. +3 attack. Follow up: Deal 1 damage to the lowest health enemy.
[*] New item - Infernal Shield. Fighter only. +10 health. Battle start: Gain +2 Armor.
[*] New item - Infernal Wand. Mage only. +5 attack. -2 health.
[/list]
[i]Dev note: A lot of players requested that the Tower have more floors, so we've increased the limit to 100, and added a new set of powerful enemies. We've also added new "infernal" weapons. While extremely expensive (30+ gold) these items raise the power cap for your party, letting you take on extremely challenging fights.[/i]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Noble Plate on your hero now gives gold when "dying" from Death's Invitation
[*] Fixed: The score increase from Death's Gift now applies even if the character is dead.
[*] Fixed: Addressed an issue with New Game+ and beyond not unlocking in some scenarios.
[*] Fixed: RNG generation for The Tower is now working correctly (and not repeating rooms and items).
[*] Fixed: Misc localization tweaks.
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.5.0 - The Tower Update
notes.content:
The Tower Update is here! This update is our largest yet, bringing an entirely new game mode, a new Manacast ability, overleveling, new localization, and more!

[h1]THE TOWER[/h1]
The Tower is a brand-new game mode. Ascend a nearly endless tower, fighting a wide variety of new bosses and enemies.
[list]
[*] 40+ new enemies and bosses.
[*] More variety in each run with procedurally generated battles.
[*] Unlock new floors by completing a run.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/a1aedfc214cd2bc431b08700c9c9b80be8318efe.png[/img]

[i]Dev note: I've had a ton of fun making this mode. I wanted to add a mode with more of an "arcade feel", where you can test the limits of what's possible - both for your party and the enemy. The Tower adds a lot more variety in the enemies that you'll encounter, and the rooms that you'll find. But be warned - the top floors are exceptionally difficult![/i]

[h1]MANACAST[/h1]
This update adds a brand-new keyword: [b]Manacast[/b]. Characters with this keyword can trigger an ability a limited number of times during a battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/1809accbf7853b3a3c4aec480c46695b53c573f2.png[/img]

The following characters have been updated to use Manacast:
[list]
[*] Taz'Gyn, of the Old Moon. Manacast 2: Summon an enemy Lesser Void Wisp. Inexhaustible.
[*] Cleric of the Dark. When this character kills an enemy gain Shield. Manacast 1: Gain Shield.
[*] Druid. Manacast 1: Summon a Dove / Raven / Wolf twice.
[*] Elemancer. When an allied elemental is summoned gain +1 Attack. Manacast 1 / 2: Summon a Lightning Wisp.
[*] Flame Adept. Also damages enemies in the same column. Manacast 1 / 2 / 3: Attack.
[*] Steel Summoner. Manacast 1: Summon a Lesser / Normal / Greater Metal Wisp.
[*] Venin Witch. Deals double damage to Poisoned characters. Manacast 1 / 2: Summon a Poisonous Slime.
[*] Xerxis. Poisonous. Manacast 1 / 2: Summon a Poison Scale.
[/list]
[i]Dev note: Manacast was added to help mitigate some of the frustration with summon builds, giving you more control over when summons appear. However, Manacast also opens up additional interesting character designs! [/i]

[h1]Overleveling[/h1]
Characters can now level up endlessly! At level 4 and above, they'll gain a specific bonus - either increasing their health, damage, mana, or the strength of their ability. You can see "overlevel bonuses" in the Book of Champions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/1e6e707b86bd863ba15a1889ddb96de9e53560bf.png[/img]

[h1]BALANCE UPDATES[/h1]
This update brings a significant balance overhaul - buffing a number of characters and artifacts. The following characters have been buffed:
[list]
[*] Armored Knight. Now has 6/9/12 health, and 1 attack.
[*] Ayma, Lightning Caller. Increased stats to 9 health, 3 attack.
[*] Cultist. Increased attack to 2
[*] Brewmaster. Now has 1 attack, 4/6/8 health, and "Counter: Restore 2 health to a damaged non-heroic ally."
[*] Butcher. Is now inexhaustible.
[*] Cleric of the Rose. Now has 1 attack, 3/4/5 health, and "Hope: Deal 1/2/3 damage to the nearest enemy in this lane."
[*] Cleric of the Path. Now has 2 attack, and "Follow Up: Restore 1/2/3 health to a damaged non-heroic ally."
[*] Druid. Now has 3 attack at level 3. Additionally, now uses Manacast.
[*] Haruspex. Now has "Doom: Deal 2/3/4 damage to a random enemy."
[*] Nyx, of the Old Moon. Increased attack to 4.
[*] Royal Guard. Now has 1/2/3 attack.
[*] Steel Summoner. Can attack from anywhere. Lesser / Normal / Greater Metal Wisps have 1 attack, but give +1/2/3 Armor.
[*] Venin Drinker. Increase health to 5/7/9. 
[*] Xerxis. Increased health to 5/7. Additionally, now uses Manacast.
[*] Ven, the Eldest. Now has 12 health, and "When a poisoned character dies, gain +1 Attack and restore 2 health."
[/list]

The following artifacts have been buffed:
[list]
[*] Blood Hex - After the first and second round, summon an enemy Blood Shade.
[*] Essence Distiller - After the first round, summon an enemy Void Wisp. (Was previously a lesser void wisp.)
[*] Pure Venin. Enemies take +2 damage from poison.
[*] Staff of the Flame. Battle Start: Deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
[*] Staff of the Sky. Battle Start: Give all allies +1 Power.
[*] Staff of the Void. Round End: Deal 1 damage to the lowest health enemy. (Previously was any random enemy.)
[*] The Arbiter's Cloak. Allies gain +3 speed. (Previously was elves and elementals only.)
[/list]

[h1]LOCALIZATION[/h1]
This update includes French and Spanish (Latin America) localization! A special thanks to Francisco Rodríguez, Milagros Saulo, Gino Ariel Orsini, and Abril Santillán for their help with Spanish localization. (And thanks for your patience with this update!)

Want to help improve the localization for this update? Check out our [url=https://www.localizor.com/the-dungeon-beneath]Localizor page[/url].

[h1]OTHER UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] New artifact. Holy Blade. Your hero has "Hope: Gain +1 Power."
[*] New artifact. Manastone. Manacast characters have +1 Mana.
[*] New artifact. Manablade. When a character manacasts, your hero gains +1 Attack.
[*] Custom run settings are now saved.
[*] Custom runs let you choose your starting "bonus" character.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Death's Grace now works correctly with characters that have armor.
[*] Winning a run on a lower difficulty no longer replaces medals in the Book of Champions that were awarded for completing a higher difficulty.
[*] Fixed several German translation errors.
[/list]

Do you have thoughts for what you'd like to see in-game? Let us know on our forums!

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.4.0 - The Beast Update
notes.content:
The Beast Update has arrived! This update is one of our largest yet, including 8 new playable characters, 3 new heroes, a new secret boss, and much more!

[h1]BEASTS AND BLOODCASTING[/h1]
This update brings a new keyword: [b]bloodcast[/b]! These abilities can be triggered once per round by right-clicking a character. Each bloodcast ability costs a certain amount of health. Bloodcasting is exclusive to the new minotaur beasts.

Beasts also bring a new faction: the Claw. Heroes with this faction will encounter more beasts at campfires.

notes.title: v1.3.3 - The Undead Update
notes.content:
The Dungeon Beneath is back from the dead! This update brings new characters, a new hero, new mechanics, new items, new artifacts, and more...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/165d873fb7571cdf01ee7b0ff55921ec28ed233e.png[/img]

[h1]SOULCASTING AND NEW CHARACTERS[/h1]
The dead have arisen! This update brings a new type of playable character - the undead. Undead characters have a new keyword: [b]Soulcasting[/b]. Whenever characters die, the undead collect their souls. In between rounds, souls can be spent to trigger special abilities known as Soulcasts. Harvest the souls of your enemies - and even your allies - and use them to cast powerful magic!

This update brings a total of nine new characters and a new hero - one of our largest updates yet:

[b]Elsbeth, From Beyond.[/b] Our newest hero! Elsbeth can spend souls in between rounds (or even at the start of battle) to deal damage to enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/8d1456942d080663afe61b7f686aa4fb1204c46d.png[/img]

[b]DEADEYE[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/20cf8ad980728644425635772fb458fce3e1e033.png[/img]

[b]FALLEN ADEPT[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/4e2358eda22a1190955dbefc6245a21bc7d66f01.png[/img]

[b]FALLEN BANNERMAN[/b]. Can be found at L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/959a3487ea92705d208474f22bb806393c833ef2.png[/img]

[b]JUGGERNAUT[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/05f3811d3c1d095c579f0f6cd40cdf63f5efda09.png[/img]

[b]NECROMANCER[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3. Skeletons are 1 attack, 3 health characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/12fd46944d83849ba5778f689ae500dbb332f9b1.png[/img]

[b]SOUL CONDUIT[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/8e8ca221b0364d25ab335c6150b135a807ec2826.png[/img]

[b]SOULDRINKER[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/39b6c81083441e64f9999d4cf3b70306bb48f094.png[/img]

[b]SOULMANCER[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/1e3fc18f59ad0734e867a66eb8a679afba8aa715.png[/img]

[b]TARUS GUARD[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/b78b0a4b12bd3b53e33d82ac3c5e7e5b85e47eae.png[/img]

[h1]ALLIANCES[/h1]
Each hero now begins with two alliances - one based on the hero, and one randomly chosen. Your alliances will increase the odds of seeing certain characters at campfires, helping you put together strategies easier. You'll be able to see a hero's alliances before starting a game, giving you more control over how you want to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/69a08e4f353200146acfddfcc616c7b17bbff920.png[/img]
There are currently nine alliances:
[list]
[*] [b]Skull[/b]. Undead are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Heart[/b]. Characters that gain and use health are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Metal[/b]. Characters that gain and use Armor are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Hammer[/b]. Dwarves are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Branch[/b]. Characters that use and benefit from summons are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Sun[/b]. Characters that gain and use Power are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Poison[/b]. Characters that use Poison abilities are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Scale[/b]. Lizardfolk are more likely to appear at campfires.
[*] [b]Death[/b]. Characters that use Doom abilities are more likely to appear at campfires.
[/list]
[i]Dev note: As more characters are added to the game, it becomes increasingly difficult to find the characters you need to make a specific strategy work. Alliances help address this concern - while still adding enough randomness to result in interesting builds. Whenever you visit a campfire, there's guaranteed to be at least one unit from your alliances.[/i]

[h1]NEW EQUIPMENT AND ARTIFACTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New equipment - Skull Charm.[/b] After a character soulcasts, gain +1 Armor.
[*] [b]New equipment - Cracked Soul.[/b] Battle Start: Gain 1 Soul. Max souls +1.
[*] [b]New artifact - Soul Vessel.[/b] Max souls +6.
[*] [b]New artifact - Summoning Bell. [/b]Battle Start: Summon two Spectral Hammers.
[/list]
[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Characters that summon now show their summon's stats and abilities.
[*] More UI and in-game features have auditory feedback when hovering over them, or interacting with them.
[*] The Book of Champions is now accessible from the title screen.
[*] You can now preview the abilities of upcoming dungeon bosses by hovering over their icon.
[*] You can now delete your save file from the settings menu. Be careful - this is permanent!
[*] ...and many small tweaks!
[/list]
[h1]LOCALIZATION[/h1]
The Dungeon Beneath is now playable in German! But that's just the start. We plan to add more languages in upcoming versions.

Note that the German translation is only 95% complete. Interested in helping finish it? You can help translate The Dungeon Beneath (into German, or any number of languages) by visiting our [url=https://www.localizor.com/the-dungeon-beneath]Localizor.com page[/url]. A special thanks to Stephan for his help with this!

[i]Dev note: we're testing out community-driven localization because we've found that community translations are often more accurate than professional translation. Additionally translation can be expensive and time-consuming. That said, this is still a work-in-progress. Expect more updates in future![/i]

[h1]CHARACTER AND HERO UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] The following characters are now undead: Sanguinist, Wrath Conduit, and Taz'gyn (Ascended Summoner).
[*] Hunter now has "Follow Up: Deal 1 damage to the lowest health enemy once / two times / three times" at L1/2/3 but now only has 1 attack.
[*] Aguatilis now has "When an ally dies gain +2/3/4 Power" at L1/2/3 but now only has 2 attack.
[*] Night Marksman, Aguatilis, Ranger, and Elder Gryx (She Who Swims Alone) are now inexhaustible.
[*] The hero Xandos III, Golden Emperor, has +1 Attack for every 5 gold (up from every 4 gold).
[*] Nyx of the Old Moon now has 3 attack (up from 2).
[/list]
[h1]ENEMY UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Primordial Flame has been reworked.
[*] The Hand of Abaddon has slightly lower health but its minions have slightly more health.
[*] Nazzatoth - increased the damage of several shadows from 1 to 2.
[*] Illifar - increased the health of several demons.
[*] The Harbinger now has 5 health (down from 6).
[/list]
[h1]OTHER UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked how score is calculated. Defeating the final boss is now worth more points. Unspent gold now counts for fewer points, and each round played subtracts from the final score. [i]Dev note: the average run should have roughly the same final score. These changes are meant to add more nuance to high-score attempts. Previously, the highest scores could only be obtained by gold farming. (That said, this is still a work-in-progress - let us know your thoughts!)[/i]
[*] Increased the cost of the Potion Belt from 10 to 12. 
[*] Increased the cost of the Holy Scepter from 12 to 14.
[*] Updated some daily challenges.
[*] Changed the speedrun achievement to require reaching a final boss in 40 rounds (down from 60). [i]Dev note: runs have gotten much faster since the game launched, making this achievement trivial. The updated achievement should be a bit more challenging - but still very manageable for specific comps.[/i]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Midas Belt (and other items) wouldn't trigger when used by a hero.
[*] Added the correct pricing for some items that were missing increased pricing at higher difficulties (Midas Belt, Death Cap, Immortal cap).
[/list]
Do you have thoughts for what you'd like to see in-game? Let us know on our forums!

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.3.2 - The Dwarven Update

v1.3.2 is finally here! This update brings new characters, new items, and new dungeon rooms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/a75ddf563e21fb97ae5f08a17257a5c139a9782f.png[/img]

The dwarves have arrived! This update brings four new dwarves and three other playable characters.

[b]Cleric of the Hammer[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3. Summoned hammers have 1 HP and deal 1/2/3 damage at L1/2/3. After attacking, hammers take 1 damage.

[b]Brewmaster[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L1, L2, and L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/6f7456800968bb27e4e7b21ea2471fbd7dafe490.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/50a6548df44d53962e630065e256bb45d00c1fb7.png[/img]
[b]Battle Thane[/b]. Begins unlocked and can be found at L2, and L3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/b8fb3c4427f195a8fbdd31a3d41d72003f7332cc.png[/img]
[b]Ven, the Eldest[/b]. Unlockable. Can only be found at L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/b16653044d3833f01f4a8f68082bfa87602d4bf7.png[/img]
[b]Aeron, Forest Spirit[/b]. Can only be found at L3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/83ac70cc83ef8bf16d2dc4c7132831e55f64c610.png[/img]

[h1]NEW HERO[/h1]
[b]Xandos, Golden Emperor[/b] is an unlockable variation of the basic hero.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/594de848d5a2237b6349dcdb9a03c5820c757090.png[/img]

[h1]NEW DUNGEON ROOMS[/h1]
In addition to unlocking new characters at the end of each run, you can now unlock new dungeon rooms.
[list]
[*] Bonfires. These upgraded campfires have five characters to choose from, instead of three. In addition, each bonfire offers a Potion of Experience for purchase.

[/list]Note that Andromalius and the Key Smith are now unlocked through the progression.

[h1]LEGENDARY DIFFICULTY[/h1]
Legendary is the hardest difficulty yet! In addition to increasing the difficulty of most battles, new enemies will appear during each of the Old God fights. Note that you’ll need to defeat New Game+++++ to unlock Legendary even if you've previously completed New Game+++++ (sorry). Additionally, [spoiler]the Portal area has a new final boss with a special achievement.[/spoiler]

[h1]CHARACTER BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Buffed Arcane Archer from 3/4 HP to 4/6 HP at L1/2.
[*] Buffed Sage of the Word from 3 HP to 4 HP at L2.
[*] Buffed Ranger from 4/5 HP to 5/7 HP at L1/2.
[*] Removed “Attacks the lowest health enemy” from Wrath Conduit. Added inexhaustible.
[/list]
[h1]NEW EQUIPMENT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Throwing Axe. Dwarf only. Counter: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
[*] Holy Axe. Dwarf only. When this character gains health, they also gain +1 Power.
[*] Star Stone. Elemental only. +1 Attack. 
[*] Follower’s Cloak. Follower only. +2 HP.
[*] Hatchling Egg. Lizardfolk only. After the first round, summon a lizardfolk Hatchling.
[*] ...also added some secrets.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Venina's Hex now has “Battle Start: Poison two random enemies.” Previously only poisoned one.

[*] Jack's Fiddle now has “When you visit a campfire or bonfire, gain 3 gold.” Was previously one 2 gold.
[*] Royal Insignia now has “Battle Start: Your hero attacks.” in addition to “Your first refresh at each campfire and store is free.”
[*] Quickdraw Quiver now has “Battle Start: Allied Archers attack twice”. Was previously only once.

[*] Berserker’s Axe and Midas Belt are now slightly cheaper but Dwarf only.

notes.content:

notes.title: v1.3.0 - The Portal Update
notes.content:
The Portal Update has arrived in The Dungeon Beneath! This update brings a number of new features, including a new area!

[h1]NEW AREA[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/e93339902fa7d2d88eb3a944b0df3aba9e420942.png[/img]
The Portal Update unlocks an entire new area! You can find the area by defeating each of the three Old Gods, then [REDACTED].

[h1]BOONS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/5baa6efbde70f6cf7a6e5df6c8a22a71127d1446.png[/img]
The Keeper's Gifts have been replaced with "Boons." After defeating one of the three Old Gods (on any difficulty) their unique Boon will appear in the Statue Room. Unlike Keeper Gifts, once you've unlocked a Boon, it will be available on all your subsequent runs. However, you can only select a single Boon at that the start of each run. Note that if you've previously defeated one of the Old Gods before the Portal Update, you'll need to defeat them again after the update to unlock the Boon. (Sorry.)

Boons:
[list]
[*] The Blood of Abaddon. Gain 8 gold.
[*] The Blood of Illifar. Gain a random Level 2 character.
[*] The Blood of Nazzatoth. Gain a random item.
[/list]

[h1]NEW ROOMS[/h1]
Five new rooms have been added throughout the Dungeon.
[list]
[*] The Keysmith. The Keysmith sells keys for The Black Market, The Giant, and The Servant of Greed.
[*] The Black Market. The Black Market sells items for 3 gold cheaper (with a minimum of 1 gold per item).
[*] The Giant. The Giant always has the same six items. Choose wisely - you can only take one!
[*] The Servant of Greed. The Servant of Greed is a challenging fight that rewards 16 Gold.
[*] The Lost Mage. The Lost Mage can be found by [REDACTED].
[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/1dd1b67577059167fc35987a55073dec928934a7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Custom Game. After defeating each of the three Old Gods, you'll unlock the "Custom Game" option from the main menu. This option lets you select your starting hero and artifact (including a few "just for fun" heroes).
[*] Healing Potions at Campfires. You can now purchase a healing potion at each Campfire for 1 gold. 
[*] Artifact Rerolls. You can now reroll artifacts for 2 gold. Unlike campfires and merchants, you won't see the same artifact twice.
[*] Aurum Worms. Be careful. You will now encounter dangerous Aurum Worms when [REDACTED]. However, defeating an Aurum Worm will [REDACTED].
[*] Four new achievements. Very Lost, Just Golden, Fate+++++, and Close the Portal.
[/list]

[h1]CHARACTER UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sharpshooter now has 1 Attack and reads "When an enemy gains Poison, deal 1/2/3 damage to them". (Previously, Sharpshooter read 'When an enemy gains Poison, deal 1 damage to them".)
[*] Amguan now has 5 health (up from 4 health).
[*] Maeledox now reads "When this character gains Power, they also gain Shield. Scheme: Curse the nearest enemy." (Previously Maeledox only had the Scheme ability.)
[*] Venin Witch now summons a Poison Slime after the first round (and another Poison Slime after the second round at L3). This is in addition to her previous ability of dealing double damage to Poisoned characters.
[*] Taz'gyn, Ascended Summoner now has Inexhaustible in addition to his previous ability.
[/list]

[h1]EQUIPMENT AND ARTIFACTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] (NEW ITEM) Death Cap. Gnome Only. When a poisoned character dies, restore 1 health.  
[*] (NEW ITEM) Berserker's Axe. Fighter Only. Gain +1 Attack if below max health.
[*] (UPDATED ITEM) Soul Stealer. When this character kills an enemy, restore 1 health. (Previously the Soul Stealer was hero-only; it's now open to all characters.)
[*] (UPDATED ARTIFACT) Spirit Shackles. The first time an ally dies, summon an Avenging Spirit. The Avenging Spirit now has 2 attack, up from 1.
[*] (UPDATED ARTIFACT) Troll Blood. When your hero kills an enemy, they restore 2 health. (Previously the effect triggered at the start of each battle.)
[*] (UPDATED ARTIFACT) Ethereal Essence. When an ally loses shield, give them +1 Attack. (Previously gave +3 Power instead.)
[/list]

[h1]ENEMY UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Abaddon's "Greed" attack now only summons three Golden Spheres (down from four).
[*] Nazzatoth no longer has a base attack; the Old God only summons Shadows.
[*] The Sightless One's "Win in 3 rounds" bonus objective has been updated to "Win in 4 rounds."
[/list]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character unlocks now require ~30% fewer points.
[*] A high-contrast mouse cursor is now available in the Settings menu.
[*] The Settings menu additionally has an option that will automatically prompt the "Reset Battle" menu if you die before resetting.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Elemancer now correctly specifies that their ability only triggers from allied elementals.
[*] Invisible characters no longer prevent the Tinkerer's bombs from exploding in certain situations.
[/list]

Do you have thoughts for what you'd like to see in-game? Let us know on our forums!

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.1.1 - The Archer Update
notes.content:
v1.1.1 is here! This update brings new characters, new heroes, new daily challenges, a new difficulty level, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/9e0a4cd40c9083d400b3062cb3684b3c2a992327.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/73358d65b6e29345e8c620ef35e6ef7cc5529742.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.1.0 - The Illifar Update
notes.content:
Illifar, King of Demons, has arrived in The Dungeon Beneath! This update also brings new characters, new artifacts, new equipment, new encounters, new types of rooms - and more!

[h1]ILLIFAR[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/3d4f6ea1d35dbb98f77d77f0444f262f5a387418.png[/img]
Illifar joins Abaddon as a new final boss. At the start of each run, you'll be able to see which old god lurks below.

With Illifar, comes two new types of rooms.
[list]
[*] [b]Andromalius and the Void.[/b] Each time you meet Andromalius, she'll transform one piece of equipment. Each piece of equipment transforms into a specific item. For example, Andromalius will always transform the Holy Scepter into the Potion Belt. Andromalius can even create some unique items...
[*] [b]Bathin's Bargain. [/b]Bathin offers a selection of optional bargains. Each bargain grants you gold; however, the bargain will raise the difficulty of the next battle.

[*] The Javelineer is a welcome addition to any armor build, providing high damage and flexibility.
[*] The Channeler offers doom builds a way to consistently trigger their effects.
[*] The Royal Guard offers healing-focused parties a powerful tank, who can power up your hero.
[/list]

In this update we're adding eight new artifacts, six new items, and many more secrets...
 
Artifacts:
[list]
[*] [b]Royal Insignia.[/b] Your first campfire or store refresh is free.
[*] [b]Troll Blood.[/b] Battle Start: Restore 2 Health to your Hero.
[*] [b]Titanic Hammer.[/b] Battle Start: Give all allies 2 Armor.
[*] [b]Staff of the Amguan.[/b] If an ally doesn't attack, give them +1 Power.
[*] [b]Holy Distiller.[/b] After the first round, summon a Holy Wisp.
[*] [b]Book of Power.[/b] Round End: Give a random allied Human +1 Power.
[*] [b]Ethereal Essence.[/b] Whenever an ally loses shield, give them +3 Power.
[*] [b]Jack's Fiddle.[/b] When you visit a campfire, gain 2 gold. (A tragic relic from before Jack's transformation.)
[/list]
Equipment:
[list]
[*] [b]Aamon's Blade. [/b]Hero Only. Counter: Gain +1 Attack.
[*] [b]Soul Stealer.[/b] Hero Only. When this character kills an enemy, restore 2 health.
[*] [b]Scavenger's Cloak.[/b] Archer only. When this character kills an enemy, summon a raven.
[*] [b]Soul Lens.[/b] When an ally dies, deal 1 damage to the nearest enemy.
[*] [b]Void Fury Ring.[/b] When this character kills an enemy, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
[*] [b]Venin Shield.[/b] +3 Health. Battle Start: Become poisoned.
[*] ...and more secret items!

[h1]NEW ENCOUNTERS[/h1]

[list]
[*] You can now refresh the hero selection when starting a run. Additionally the hero selection screen offers more information about your run.
[*] Reduced duplicates when refreshing the Merchant or Campfire. (You will not see duplicates twice in a row though you may see duplicates after that).
[/list]

[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ares, the Lost Knight now has the ability "Whenever this character would gain armor, they gain +3 Power instead." Previously Ares only gained +2 power.
[*] The Enraged Ooze enemy hero has been reskinned as the Metallic Ooze.
[*] Patch notes are now viewable in-game.
[*] Updated Faxel Fetterbite's ability to "Counter: Deal 1 damage to the nearest enemy, then change lanes." Previously Faxel would deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
[*] The Mind Reaver is now less difficult.

notes.title: v1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.6 is here! This update brings a new hero, new Characters, new equipment, new potions, and a whole lot more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/1fe7cf59f680e7aa75ceaa9042c6c686a89175e2.png[/img]

[h1]NEW HERO[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/d41ffaf243639ee6b6307574a1395c59d957d36e.png[/img]
The young prince Xandos III is a brand new hero. While weaker than other heroes, Xandos begins with the fabled Dawn Crown. This artifact increases your party limit by 1.

[h1]NEW CHARACTERS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/dcd824a097815bae787713f5944c9fb5c374b649.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/4b0bb3ecd6d84fed2f44ff5139e3124ac1b1b1b2.png[/img]
The Tinkerer is a blast! This Character has a powerful summon ability - but be careful. The Tinkerer requires a large amount of planning to make sure that bombs don't explode in your face!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/f168164c18b4137624eb18e2b67ba2dd42c5d75f.png[/img]
The Elemancer is a powerful mage. Every time you summon an elemental, the Elemancer gets +1 Attack until the end of a battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/e44be02900f8130e95915b882f0165929120415e.png[/img]
The Blood Leech fits into almost any Doom build - or pair it with the Elemancer for unmatched damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/844a3c3d848dfd09165a3051841f06d7d29b98e7.png[/img]
While the Tanner is weaker than most Characters, they can make you rich. Just make sure to swap them out before Abaddon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/9b7beed352077c74acdcea79c893f10e10906fb3.png[/img]
Similar to the Tanner, the Smuggler gives Lizardfolk builds a powerful economy play.

[h1]CHARACTER STATS[/h1]
We've added Character stats! The Book of Champions now tracks a variety of stats for each Character, accessible by hovering over the magnifying glass. Additionally, any Characters that defeat Abaddon are given a special medal in The Book of Champions.

[h1]NEW ITEMS[/h1]
In 1.0.6 we're introducing items that are restricted to specific Character types.
[list]
[*] Immortal Belt (Dwarves only) - "Counter: Restore 1 health."
[*] Sanguine Wand (Elves only) - "After the first round, summon a Blood Wisp."
[*] Necrotic Wand (Elves only) - "Round End: Deal 1 damage to the lowest health enemy."
[*] Green Scale Wand (Elves only) - "Round End: Give a random allied Beast 1 armor."
[*] Martyr's Plate (Humans only) - "Death: Give +1 Attack to all allies."
[*] Noble Plate (Humans only) - "+1 HP. Death: Gain 1 gold."
[*] Chain Mail (Humans only) - "+2 HP -1 Speed"
[*] Lightning Fang (Lizardfolk only) - "Round End: Gain +1 Power."
[*] Poisonous Fang (Lizardfolk only) - "Attacks apply poison."
[*] Venin Cap (Gnomes only) - "Follow Up: Deal 1 damage to all poisoned enemies."
[/list]

We've also added two new potions to the Witch's shop:
[list]
[*] Potion of Transformation - "Transform an archer into a random Level 3 character. The character loses all their equipment. Consumable."
[*] Mirroring Potion - "Transform a fighter into a basic copy of a random party member. The character loses all their equipment. Consumable."
[/list]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now click anywhere or use the spacebar to skip dialogue.
[*] You can now change your difficulty for Daily Challenges.
[*] Renamed "Weaken" to "Curse". (This was causing some confusion, as "weakness" implies the character deals less damage.)
[*] Updated tutorials.
[/list]

[h1]CHARACTER UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hypogean now has "Scheme: Restore 1 health for each allied Lizardfolk." Previously Hypogean gained armor rather than restoring health.
[*] Divine Protector now has 6/9/12 health at Level 1/2/3 (previously had 6/7/8 health).
[*] Amguan now has "Scheme: Give +1/+2 Power to all  allied Lizardfolk." Previously it did not target itself.
[*] Sage of the Word now has "Hope: Give +1/+2 Power to a random ally." Previously Sage of the Word had "Hope: Gain +1 Power."
[/list]

[h1]RELIC CHANGES[/h1]
We've updated four relics to make them less restrictive. Thanks for the suggestion zoknar!
[list]
[*] Taurian Scripture - "Allied Beasts and Lizardfolk gain +1 Health." Was previously "Allied Beasts gain +1 Health."
[*] Hammer of the Old Earth - "Allied Dwarves and Gnomes gain +2 Health." Was previously "Allied Dwarves gain +2 Health."
[*] The Arbiter's Cloak - "Allied Elves and Elementals gain +3 Speed." Was previously "Allied Elves gain +3 Speed."
[*] Book of Law - "Allied Humans and Dwarves gain +1 Health." Was previously "Allied Humans gain +1 Health."
[/list]

[h1]OTHER BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bitter Tooth now spawns with fewer rats. (In most cases.)
[*] The Servant of Fire now has less health on New Game+ and higher.
[*] The Mind Reaver now has less health.
[*] Headless Simulae no longer attack random enemies. Instead they move after attacking.
[*] The Corrupted Altar now deals 2 damage, rather than applying Weakness / Curse.
[/list]

Do you have thoughts for what you'd like to see in-game? Let us know on our forums!

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.5 is here! This update brings two big new changes: The Daily Challenge and The Book of Champions.

[h1]THE DAILY CHALLENGE[/h1]
The Daily Challenge is a brand-new game mode. Each Daily Challenge adds a twist to your adventure: dive into the dungeon with a special scenario and a unique curse. The Daily Challenge refreshes each day at 4:00am UTC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/43bc418b269d014e635595e1667e31771290d064.png[/img]

[h1]THE BOOK OF CHAMPIONS[/h1]
Curious what characters lurk in the depths? The Book of Champions shows all the characters that can be found at Campfires in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/d10eefe78f462ad1d5051389869d72e892d48e00.png[/img]

[h1]NEW CHARACTERS[/h1]
With this update, we've added two powerful Poison-based units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/83a9422142fccbbbad8e8b8dd872a16b5cedd91e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Venomancer.[/b] Venomancer is a powerful poison-based character, capable of keeping multiple enemies under control.
[*] [b]The Devourer.[/b] The Devourer has the highest health of any character so-far. While this elemental cube doesn't have its own attack, it can summon Poisonous Slimes to attack for it.
[/list]

[h1]ABADDON UPDATES[/h1]
We've made significant changes to Abaddon in this update:
[list]
[*] [b]Greed.[/b] Abaddon's Greed form (summoning four golden spheres) will no longer occur on New Game-.
[*] [b]Pride.[/b] Abaddon's Pride form (setting the highest health enemy to 1) will no longer occur on New Game- or New Game.
[*] [b]Unlocking higher difficulties requires that you now defeat Abaddon.[/b] 
[/list]

[i]Developer Note: our original intention was that most runs would be defeated by Abaddon and that the success of a run would be measured by how long you survived. However, our view on this has been evolving - thanks in large part to the wonderful feedback we've received. For this reason, we've made Abaddon easier on New Game- and New Game. [/i]

[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]You can now cycle through a unit's inventory by right-clicking multiple times.[/b] 
[*] [b]Veninic Simulae and Clypaen Simulae no longer target random enemies.[/b] 
[*] [b]You can now disable unit animation (or bouncing) in settings.[/b] 
[*] [b]Venina's Hex (poison artifact) will now only target enemy heroes if no other target is available.[/b] 
[*] ...and many smaller changes!
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]When you pick up an item, only characters who can equip it are highlighted in green.[/b] 
[*] [b]If you have a Multiclass unit, you now encounter items from all classes in stores.[/b] 
[*] [b]Multiclass units can now be targeted by buffs that target specific classes.[/b] 
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.4 is here! In this update we wanted to focus on balance issues, addressing some of the toughest enemies and the most underused allies. (We even made Abaddon a little easier*.)

[h1]LIZARDFOLK UPDATE[/h1]

The biggest update is our change to Lizardfolk characters. The original "death & sacrifice" focused Lizardfolk felt underwhelming and overlapped too much with summon compositions. So we've redesigned Lizardfolk, giving them their very own "Lizardfolk" type and a unique "Scheme" keyword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/d7ab09c44feb049e1a153f2bd8ac773bbbcc3420.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b] Scheme keyword.[/b] "Scheme" triggers whenever the character does not attack.
[*] [b]PRALIATOR (New).[/b] The Lizardfolk have a brand-new unit with the ability to steam-roll weaker enemies.
[*] [b]HYPOGEAN (Updated).[/b] The Hypogean was reworked to provide the Lizardfolk build a powerful tank. 
[*] [b]AMGUAN  (Updated).[/b] The Amguan now offers powerful buffs to Lizardfolk.
[/list]
Note: Taur, the Exiled has also been updated to work with Lizardfolk.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]

Three new slime-based encounters have been added to The Upper Dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/4de836694791c213dc74f31a0df4bedf92e59050.png[/img]

[h1]NEW LOOT[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Mystery Potions.[/b] The Witch can now sell a Mystery Potion that transforms into a random item when purchased.
[*] [b]Potion of Greater Versatility.[/b] Mages who use a Potion of Greater Versatility can use equipment from any class.
[*] [b]Cursed Amulet.[/b] The Cursed Amulet grants +2 Attack but deals the wearer 1 damage after attacking.
[*] [b]Counterfeit Coins.[/b] Counterfeit Coins are a new artifact that reduces the cost of buying characters by 2 gold.
[/list]

[h1]UNIT UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The Hunter has been redesigned, now dealing 1 damage to the lowest health enemy after attacking.[/b] [i]Developer note: While the Hunter was a powerful unit in certain circumstances, they weren't seeing much play. In testing, we found this change makes them a more natural fit for builds that need a little crowd control, as well as "Doom"-focused builds.[/i]
[*] [b]Level 1 Rangers will no longer be found in The Upper Dungeon (though Level 2 and 3 Rangers can still be found later on).[/b] [i]Developer note: There were too many summon-synergizing characters in The Upper Dungeon, making summon builds a natural choice for most runs. In this update (and future updates) we aim to better balance the number of units per composition in each area.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]You can now sell items in treasure chest rooms.[/b] 
[*] [b]Units "bounce" a little slower on higher fastforward settings.[/b] 
[/list]

[h1]ENEMY BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Abaddon is now easier on New Game-.[/b] [i]Developer note: Abaddon being too difficult is the most common piece of feedback we've gotten - so perhaps this issue needs a bit of context. We chose to make Abaddon VERY hard because we wanted to celebrate amazing runs. Without a challenging end-boss, a "perfect" run feels a lot like a "pretty-good" run. They both end up at the same place. In our view, the true test of a run isn't whether you beat Abaddon but how long you can survive. However, we realize that not everyone might feel this way, so we've decided to make Abaddon substantially easier on New Game-.[/i]
[*] [b]The Hand of Abaddon now only gains attack if an allied monster dies.[/b] Previously the ability triggered when any ally died, which was a hard counter to the Void Summoner.
[*] [b]The Firis boss fight no longer has Cursed Urns.[/b] 
[*] [b]Clypaen Simulae now has 10HP (down from 12HP).[/b] 
[*] [b]Mass of Orbs now only summon three Wandering Orbs on death (previously would fill the board).[/b] 
[*] [b]Lycanthropes now only have 6HP (down from 8HP).[/b] 
[*] [b]Bitter Tooth is now slightly easier on New Game+ and up.[/b] 
[*] [b]Abyss Guardian is now slightly easier on New Game+ and up.[/b] 
[*] [b]The Veninic Simulae encounter now has more enemies.[/b] 
[*] [b]The Orb Progenitor encounter now has more enemies.[/b] 
[*] [b]The Mind Reaver now has 50HP (previously had 40HP) and attacks twice.[/b] 
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The Treasure Chest bonus objective now only occurs if there's room to spawn a Treasure Chest.[/b] 
[*] [b]The game now starts even if there's an error recovering the save file.[/b] 
[*] [b]The Ember Spirit no longer infinitely loops if killed by a "Hope" trigger.[/b] Thanks jstowe4!
[*] [b]Numerous other small fixes![/b] 
[/list]

Stay tuned for more changes soon!

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.3 is officially live. We wanted to bring you a quick update to fix some "quality-of-life" issues with the game - as well as to bring some small balance adjustments and bug fixes.

Note that you may need to restart your Steam client to see the update.

[h1]POISON MINI-EXPANSION[/h1]
While the focus of this update was on quality-of-life improvements, we wanted to add a few new characters to keep things fresh and to lay the foundation for future updates.

[h2]New Characters[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306384/615d58fd83a7da2a2a0aa5476d1fadc28b755823.png[/img]
ROGUE (L1 Gnome Fighter)
1 D / 3 HP / 6 S
Poisonous.
Inexhaustible.

ROGUE (L2 Gnome Fighter)
2 D / 5 HP / 6 S
Poisonous.
Inexhaustible.

ROGUE (L3 Gnome Fighter)
3 D / 7 HP / 6 S
Poisonous.
Inexhaustible.

VENIN WITCH (L2 Human Mage)
2 D / 4 HP / 2 S
Deals double damage against Poisoned characters.

VENIN WITCH (L3 Human Mage)
3 D / 5 HP / 2 S
Deals double damage against Poisoned characters.

[h2]New Relics[/h2]
[*] [b]Pure Venin.[/b] Enemies take +1 damage from poison.
[*] [b]Venina's Hex.[/b] Battle Start: Poison a random enemy.

...plus a new bonus objective!

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[*] [b]You can now sell equipment.[/b] We've changed the flow for selling equipment and characters. Note that this also allows you to sell unwanted Potions of Experience.
[*] [b]Faster battles.[/b] You can now speed up battles even more with "5x" fast forward. Still not fast enough? We've added an option in the settings menu to skip Battle Banners to speed up battles even more.
[*] [b]Multiple unlocks.[/b] After finishing a run you can now unlock multiple new characters (if your score is high enough).
[*] [b]Fewer frustrating situations for summon builds.[/b] We've done a lot of tweaks to make fewer situations that frustrate summoning. Bonus objectives and hazard rooms have been updated to clog up your board less. The Druid now summons at the end of the first round to give you more control over your board. Finally we've tweaked the logic for the Essence Collector and Spirit Shackles artifacts so that they will always summon (so long as there's board space). That said, board-space management is still a critical part of the summon comp!

[h1]CHARACTER BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[*] [b]The Armorsmith now gives +2/3/4 Armor (was previously +2/4/6).[/b] 
[*] [b]The Druid now summons at the end of the first round, rather than the start of each battle.[/b] 
[*] [b]Elder Gryx now has 7 HP (was previously 9 HP) and is no longer Inexhaustible.[/b] 
[*] [b]Marianna now has 2 Attack.[/b] 

[h1]OTHER BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[*] [b]Encounters in The Upper Dungeon now have more board layout variations.[/b] 
[*] [b]Blood Wisps no longer injure themselves after attacking.[/b] Blood Wisps are now simply 1/1 Elementals.
[*] [b]The Hand of Abaddon now gains +1 Attack whenever an ally dies.[/b] 
[*] [b]Simulae Prime now starts with 1 Attack.[/b] 
[*] [b]The Reanimated Colossus now has 16 HP (was previously 18 HP).[/b] 
[*] [b]Armored gloves now give +1 HP and +1 Armor at the start of battle (previously gave +2 HP).[/b] 
[*] [b]The Potion of Experience now costs 3 Gold (was previously 2 Gold) and the Potion of Mastery now costs 8 Gold (was previously 5 Gold).[/b] 
[*] [b]Flit Fetterbite now has 6 HP (was previously 8 HP).[/b] 

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[*] [b]Characters keep extra XP when leveling up. [/b] 
[*] [b]All Wisps are now correctly Elemental type.[/b] 
[*] [b]The first battle in The Underneath and The Abyss will now always contain a Potion of Experience.[/b] 
[*] [b]Cyril, Master Animist and Amguan now work correctly with Esscence Collecter and Spirit Shackles.[/b] 
[*] [b]The battle no longer starts prematurely if you hit "space" on the enemy preview screen.[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.2 [/h1]
Version 1.0.2 is live! While arguably not the most exciting update, we wanted to quickly fix a handful of critical bugs from the last version.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Unlocking a unit after defeating Abaddon no longer soft-locks the game.[/b] Thanks TacticalNuance!
[*] [b]Fighting Rat Tooth with a Haruspex in your party no longer causes an infinite loop. [/b]This occured on New Game- where Dire Rats only have 1 HP.
[*] [b]Multiclass characters no longer revert to their original class when leveling up.[/b] Thanks AHotSipOfColdTea!
[*] [b]Defeating Ember Spirit by killing the Spirit Urn no longer unlocks the Overwhelming Power achievements. [/b]Thanks kajun!
[/list]
If you don't see these changes, please verify that you've updated to v1.0.2. This may require restarting Steam. You can see your current version by holding "V" on the title screen.

Stay tuned! More updates are on their way.

Happy adventuring!
